verdict.rationale: Gazebo publishes documentation, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. The probes found no such resource: https://gazebosim.org/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and the markdown variant of the getstarted docs also returned 404. Nothing else in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
